name: Conservation of light energy at a material
meaning: The fractions of incoming light energy reflected, absorbed, and transmitted add to 1 (scattered light is counted in R or T). Dimensionless.

name: Exponential absorption
meaning: Intensity remaining after depth x (m) in an absorber with absorption coefficient α (m⁻¹); I₀ is the intensity just inside the surface.

name: Law of reflection
meaning: The angle of reflection equals the angle of incidence, both measured from the surface normal.

name: Normal-incidence reflectance
meaning: Fraction of light reflected at a boundary between indices n₁ and n₂ when light hits straight on; about 0.04 for glass in air.

name: Index of refraction
meaning: Speed of light in vacuum c divided by the speed v of wave crests in the material. Dimensionless, always about 1 or more for visible light.

name: Wavelength in a material
meaning: The wavelength shrinks by the factor n inside a material; the frequency (and photon energy) is unchanged.

name: Snell's law
meaning: Relates the angles (from the normal) on each side of a boundary between indices n₁ and n₂.

name: Critical angle
meaning: Beyond this angle of incidence, light in the higher-index material is totally internally reflected.

name: Thin-lens equation
meaning: Relates focal length f, object distance d_o, and image distance d_i (all in m); f is positive for a converging lens.

name: Lens power
meaning: Optical power in diopters (m⁻¹) for focal length f in meters.
